input: Accessibility: the .btn-ghost style has text contrast of 2.9:1 against the page background, below the 4.5:1 minimum from WCAG 2.2 AA. Also the icon-only close button in Modal.jsx has no aria-label, so screen readers say just button. Casing: it is aria-label, lowercase with a hyphen.
wrong:
Title: Fix contrast
- .btn-ghost is 3.9:1 but needs 4.5:1
- add an aria-label to the close button in Modal.jsx

Title: Button labels
- close button has no aria-label
- contrast needs 7:1 on .btn-ghost
correct_alts:
Low contrast and unlabeled close button
- The .btn-ghost text reaches only 2.9:1 where WCAG 2.2 AA asks for 4.5:1.
- The icon-only close button in Modal.jsx lacks an aria-label, so a screen reader announces only button.
- Add the attribute and darken the text.

Two accessibility defects in the ghost button and modal
Contrast for .btn-ghost is 2.9:1 and must be raised to at least 4.5:1. Separately, Modal.jsx renders a close icon with no aria-label, which leaves it unnamed for assistive technology.
